data.title: NIRON MAGNETICS RECEIVES CONDITIONAL $150 MILLION DEPARTMENT OF WAR COMMITMENT
data.description: Niron Magnetics is set to receive financial support of around $150 million for the construction and equipment of their manufacturing plant in Sartell, Minnesota. The plant will specialize in producing Rare-earth-free Iron Nitride magnets, which do not rely on scarce rare earth materials. This innovative technology paves the way for a fresh method in domestic magnet manufacturing. The funding includes a 20-year direct loan commitment, indicating a significant long-term investment in this venture.

data.title: THOUSANDS OF CONTRA COSTA COUNTY TEAMSTERS SET STRIKE DATE
data.description: More than 2,000 employees of Contra Costa County are currently looking to negotiate cost of living adjustments in mediation. Specifically, over 2,000 Teamsters in the county have indicated that they plan to go on strike starting August 19 if a new contract deal is not finalized by then.

data.title: HealthConnect One to Host Community Birth Support Luncheon in Oak Bluffs, Kicking Off Black Breastfeeding Week
data.description: A cost-free gathering is set to unite doulas, birth workers, and families to promote birth equity on Martha's Vineyard. The event, taking place in Oak Bluffs, Massachusetts on August 7, 2026, will feature a special appearance by actress Naturi Naughton. HealthConnect One, a nationwide nonprofit focused on promoting healthy practices, will be organizing the event.

data.title: Uranium Royalty Appoints New Directors to the Board
data.description: On August 7, 2026, Uranium Royalty Corp. (NASDAQ: UROY) based in Lakewood, Colorado, welcomed two new members, Kevin McQuilkin and Peter Rozenauers, to its Board of Directors.
